$comment: Vercel Hobby only accepts cron expressions that fire once per day; anything more frequent is refused at deploy time. The schedules below are therefore daily and staggered ten minutes apart so they never contend for the same runtime. IMPORTANT: outbox-drain and email-queue-drain are what actually deliver e-mails and notifications, so on this plan a webhook side-effect can wait up to 24 hours. That is a placeholder, not a working configuration — drive those two from an external scheduler (GitHub Actions, Upstash QStash) hitting the same routes with the CRON_SECRET bearer, or move to Pro and restore the original schedules recorded below.
